name: Jyothy Labs Ltd
title: Jyothy Labs Ltd - 532926 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin fell ~400bp to 45.2% on crude-linked input inflation and lower realisations; management gave no FY27 margin guide and flagged near-term pressure, with only ~4% price hikes taken in March.

capex.quote: Similar. It will be in similar range only. Yes.

triggers.label: Price hike ~4% taken in March
triggers.quote: we have taken pricing action to the tune of around 4% in the month of March.

triggers.label: Gross margin 45.2%, down ~400bp
triggers.quote: Gross margin was at 45.2%, down about 400 basis points, driven by input cost inflation and lower realizations.

triggers.label: No FY27 margin guidance
triggers.quote: At this stage, we will be constrained to give any guidance on margin front.

triggers.label: LABSA up 60-65% since January
triggers.quote: if you look at January, and if you look at prices today, they are up by 60%, 65%.

triggers.label: Personal Care up 20% in Q4
triggers.quote: The segment grew by 20% in value and volume in Q4.

guidance.quote: we will be constrained to give any guidance on margin front.
Similar. It will be in similar range only.
So, rate should be around 25% to 26%.

red_flags.label: Margin compression, no FY27 guide
red_flags.quote: At this stage, we will be constrained to give any guidance on margin front.

red_flags.label: Dishwash price cuts and grammage competition
red_flags.quote: Competitive intensity remains high with several players reducing MRPs and offering more quantity at the same price.

evasions.quote: At this stage, we will be constrained to give any guidance on margin front.
No, I cannot give that number just now.
And at appropriate time, we will let the street know about our acquisition decision.
